items.name: Knuckle Duster
items.description: This bit of hardened metal, favored by street toughs, is typically made of brass and features four finger holes so that it can sit atop the knuckles, adding extra power to a punch.

items.name: Dueling Pistol
items.description: Made for settling disputes when diplomacy fails, dueling pistols are finely crafted and made to fit easily into a holster or pocket. Noble and wealthy merchants in both Alkenstar and Dongun Hold often own matching pairs of dueling pistols in case they're called upon to address a challenge-though this practice has become increasingly rare in the modern age.

defensiveAbilities.name: Quickest Draw
defensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Sharkosa is aware of at least one of her enemies and not Off-Guard

Trigger Sharkosa rolls for initiative

Effect Sharkosa makes two melee Strikes, or draws her pistol and makes a ranged Strike, against an enemy she is aware of.

offensiveAbilities.name: Concussive Fist
offensiveAbilities.description:
A living creature hit by Sharkosa's knuckle duster must attempt a DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is immune to this ability for the next 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is confused for 1 round and falls Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Golden Bullets
offensiveAbilities.description: Sharkosa's supernatural connection to gold allows her to alter the trajectory of her gold-cased bullets in flight. As long as her target is within 120 feet, Sharkosa gains a +1 circumstance bonus to ranged Strikes against targets with lesser cover and a +2 circumstance bonus to ranged Strikes against targets with standard or greater cover.

offensiveAbilities.name: One-Two Punch
offensiveAbilities.description: Sharkosa makes three melee Strikes with her knuckle duster. Each Strike counts against her multiple attack penalty as usual.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reload Trick
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements No enemies are within 60 feet of Sharkosa and her dueling pistol is loaded

Frequency once per minute

Effect Sharkosa makes two dueling pistol Strikes, reloading after each shot.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Sharkosa deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
